typeDefinitions.annotation:
Transfer Frame Version Numbers are 4 bits long
CCSDS References add 1 to the binary value when counting versions in english (e.g. TM & TC are "version 1" but 0b00)
Until the release of USLP, TFVN were 2 bits long
With the addition of USLP two bits were added to the trailing end that serve as the 2 most significant bits
(i.e. on the wire USLP sends 0b1100)
See section 3.2.2.2 of USLP Overview (CCSDS 700.1-G-1),
section 4.1.2.2.2 of AOS (CCSDS 732.0-B-5),
section 4.3.2 of Space Data Link Protocol Summary (CCSDS 130.2-G-3),
& table 3-1 in Overview of Space Comms Protocols (CCSDS 130.0-G-4)

events.name: ComCcsds.fprimeRouter.FileOutContextTableFull
events.format: Buffer-to-context table full on fileOut; context will be lost for this buffer
events.annotation:

fileOut. The buffer is still forwarded, but its context cannot be
restored on return and will be returned empty.

unknownDataOut. The buffer is still forwarded, but its context cannot be
restored on return and will be returned empty.

events.name: ComCcsds.fprimeRouter.BufferContextNotFound
events.format: Returned buffer not found in context table; returning with empty context
events.annotation:
A buffer returned on fileBufferReturnIn was not found in the
buffer-to-context table. The buffer is still returned, but with an
empty context.
